scenario: User asks in Chinese but the knowledge base is written in English.
required_policy_text: 知識庫全文為英文，中文查詢詞對它無效

scenario: Chinese question must be translated into English technical terms before searching.
required_policy_text: 中文問題必須抽出對應的英文技術詞一起查

scenario: A single query is not enough to answer.
required_policy_text: 一次查詢不足以作答

scenario: Scores cluster in a narrow band so term frequency cannot rank relevance.
required_policy_text: 擠在很窄的區間

scenario: Question spans more than one functional area of the product.
required_policy_text: 每個區塊各查一次

scenario: Agent must not declare the knowledge base empty after one failed query.
required_policy_text: 不得因為第一次查不到就宣告知識庫沒有答案

scenario: AI Agent adapter must repeat the retrieval discipline.
required_policy_text: 中文問題必須抽出英文技術詞一起查

scenario: AI Chat Web adapter must repeat the retrieval discipline.
required_policy_text: 不得只查一次就宣告知識庫沒有答案

scenario: Search returns match-centred snippets, not the whole chunk.
required_policy_text: 是片段，不是該 Chunk 的全文

scenario: Agent must not conclude the knowledge base lacks content just because the snippet omits it.
required_policy_text: 不得以「片段沒有提到」為由，斷定知識庫沒有該內容

scenario: Truncated but on-topic sources must be expanded before judging sufficiency.
required_policy_text: 取得完整內容，再判斷證據是否充分

scenario: Partial evidence must be labelled, not silently stripped of citations.
required_policy_text: 而不是整段撤掉引用

scenario: AI Agent adapter must repeat the snippet rule.
required_policy_text: 不得以片段未涵蓋為由省略

scenario: AI Chat Web adapter must repeat the snippet rule.
required_policy_text: 不得以片段未涵蓋為由斷定知識庫沒有該內容

scenario: iTest interpreter commands are not equivalent to their native Tcl counterparts.
required_policy_text: iTest 直譯器指令與原生 Tcl 不等價

scenario: Command usage must be checked against the Limitation clauses in the command table.
required_policy_text: 必須先取得該指令在 `command_syntax.htm` 指令表中的條目

scenario: Native Tcl behaviour must not be assumed before verification.
required_policy_text: 不得以原生 Tcl 的行為作答

scenario: iTest interpreter, Tcl interpreter and Tcl Shell Session are separate environments.
required_policy_text: 三個執行環境不可混用

scenario: Agent must not declare one environment's syntax wrong for another without evidence.
required_policy_text: 不得把某一環境的寫法宣告為另一環境的錯誤寫法

scenario: AI Agent adapter must repeat the iTest versus Tcl rule.
required_policy_text: 未查證前不得以原生 Tcl 行為作答

scenario: AI Chat Web adapter must repeat the iTest versus Tcl rule.
required_policy_text: 三個獨立環境，不可混用

scenario: Untrusted text must be passed through --query-file, never the command line.
required_policy_text: 必須以 `--query-file` 傳遞，不得填入指令列

scenario: Policy must state why the command line is unsafe.
required_policy_text: 含 `$( )` 或反引號的查詢字串會在腳本收到之前就被執行

scenario: Untrusted sources must be enumerated so the rule is actionable.
required_policy_text: 受測設備回傳的錯誤訊息、回應內容或日誌片段

scenario: The retrieval-quality rule for whole-paste queries must survive, only its transport changes.
required_policy_text: 整段直接查一次，完整子字串命中會額外加分

scenario: When metacharacters must be stripped, the agent has to disclose it.
required_policy_text: 在回覆中揭露已做過剝除

scenario: AI Agent adapter must repeat the query-file rule.
required_policy_text: 一律以 `--query-file <path>` 傳遞

scenario: AI Chat Web adapter must repeat the query-file rule.
required_policy_text: 必須以 `--query-file <path>` 傳遞

scenario: Unverified index results must not be cited.
required_policy_text: 不得把該結果寫進 `【知識庫來源】`

scenario: integrity_error must stop citation entirely.
required_policy_text: 一律停止引用，依錯誤處理流程降級

scenario: Clamped or truncated results must not be claimed as complete.
required_policy_text: 不得宣稱已檢索全部相關內容

scenario: Every step belongs to one of the two execution layers.
required_policy_text: 兩層執行模型

scenario: Native language syntax shapes must not be applied to the iTest layer.
required_policy_text: 不得把原生語言的語法形狀套進 iTest 層

scenario: A name absent from the command table is not an interpreter command.
required_policy_text: 指令表沒有列出的名稱，不是 iTest 直譯器指令

scenario: The Python side has its own command table that must be checked.
required_policy_text: command_syntax_python.htm

scenario: When a page's example is a screenshot, evidence must come from sibling pages.
required_policy_text: 必須到同一功能區塊的其他頁面取得佐證

scenario: A syntax must not be declared wrong without knowledge base evidence.
required_policy_text: 不得無據宣告某寫法錯誤

scenario: AI Agent adapter must carry the two-layer execution model.
required_policy_text: 兩層執行模型

scenario: AI Chat Web adapter must carry the two-layer execution model.
required_policy_text: 兩層執行模型

scenario: The response must surface how many results are snippets.
required_policy_text: `truncated_count` 是本次被截短的筆數

scenario: Absence must not be claimed before full text is fetched.
required_policy_text: 在宣告知識庫沒有某內容之前，必須先對相關的 chunk 取完整內容
